resources.string: Sign out of Stremio? Your sources and library stay on this computer.
Failed. Click resume to try again.
The app closed unexpectedly while your graphics card was decoding a video, so hardware decoding is off now. You can turn it back on in Settings > Playback.
No downloads. Right-click a stream to download it.
Nothing queued. Right-click a movie, show or episode to add it.
The best stream in this quality starts by itself. If there isn\'t one, the next lower quality is used.
Downloads are still running. Quit anyway? They pause and can be resumed next time.
Last crash %1$s. It stays on this computer until you copy it.
Your graphics card decodes videos, for smooth playback that hardly uses the processor. Turn it off if videos show wrong colours or glitches.
The new language is used the next time the app starts.
Release %1$s has no .flatpak attached. Attach the .flatpak from the dist folder to the GitHub release.
Release %1$s has no .flatpak.sha256 file attached, so the download can\'t be checked. Attach both files from the dist folder to the GitHub release.

The update was saved as %1$s and handed to your software centre. If nothing opened, install it from a terminal:

%2$s

Then restart the app.
